Step 1: 1599 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
Step 2: Days from 04-28 to end of April: 3 days (29, 30 → 2 days? Wait: April has 30 days, so 28 → 30 is 2 days left in April). Actually: 28 Apr to 30 Apr = 2 days.  
Step 3: Remaining days after April: 183 − 2 = 181 days left.  
May: 31 days → 181 − 31 = 150  
June: 30 days → 150 − 30 = 120  
July: 31 days → 120 − 31 = 89  
August: 31 days → 89 − 31 = 58  
September: 30 days → 58 − 30 = 28  
October: 31 days → 28 − 31 = −3 means date is in October: October 1 + 28 days = October 29.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-10-29
